env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOOS=linux
env GOARCH=amd64
env GOAMD64=v1
env CGO_ENABLED=0

cd m
# Explicit aliases make both selected package clauses legal imports.
logos build -tags=extra ./...
env GOOS=windows
logos build -tags=extra ./...
env GOOS=linux
logos eject -o out
exists out/windows/value_windows.go
exists out/tagged/value.go
cd out
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build -tags=extra ./...
env GOOS=windows
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build -tags=extra ./...

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/ownednames

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package variants

func Value() int { return 1 }

-- m/owner/type_linux.lgo --
package linuxowner

type hidden int

const func Make() hidden { return 21 }

-- m/owner/type_windows.lgo --
package windowsowner

type hidden int

const func Make() hidden { return 42 }

-- m/windows/value_windows.lgo --
package windows

import owner "example.com/ownednames/owner"

const value = owner.Make()

var _ [42-int(value)]struct{}
var _ [int(value)-42]struct{}

func Value() int { return int(value) }

-- m/tagged/value.lgo --
//go:build linux && extra

package tagged

import owner "example.com/ownednames/owner"

const value = owner.Make()

var _ [21-int(value)]struct{}
var _ [int(value)-21]struct{}

func Value() int { return int(value) }
